quote.translation: What lies above and what lies below the horizontal line stand in contradictory opposition: the upper part represents reality (`+`) and the lower part nihility (`-`), whilst the left side represents actuality (R) and the right side non-actuality (R′).
Necessity (N) and contingency (C) stand in contradictory opposition on the side of actuality, necessity belonging to the domain of reality and contingency to the domain of nihility.
